metadata.name: The Age of AI
metadata.description: The interview show where the roles are reversed: Mira, an AI, calls real people and asks the questions — live, on the record.

metadata.name: The DP Pod: The Do Positive Podcast
metadata.description: Dan and Patrick's daily antidote to doomscrolling: the most consequential developments in science and tech with sources and honest disagreement, a daily mindset principle for good mental health (Think Positive — the first show to take mental health as seriously as the science), and one concrete action with real numbers — The Lever. Plus the Do Positive Dispatch: what listeners actually did. Do something about it.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Environmental Intelligence
metadata.description: The environmental compliance briefing for Canadian practitioners, published every other weekday. Each episode opens with a scannable Compliance Brief you can forward to your team, then regulatory updates across provincial and federal jurisdictions, contaminated sites and remediation news, and a practitioner field lesson with the most common mistake and its fix.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Fascinating Frontiers
metadata.description: Daily space and astronomy news: NASA and SpaceX missions, ESA operations, exoplanet and James Webb discoveries, and the engineering behind humanity's push into the cosmos — with ongoing story tracking across Starship, Artemis, and deep-space science. For space enthusiasts, engineers, and the curious.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Frontières Fascinantes
metadata.description: Actualités quotidiennes sur l'espace et l'astronomie : missions NASA et SpaceX, opérations de l'ESA, découvertes d'exoplanètes et du James Webb, et l'ingénierie derrière la conquête spatiale de l'humanité — avec un suivi des actualités sur Starship, Artemis et la science de l'espace profond. Pour les passionnés d'espace, les ingénieurs et les curieux.

metadata.name: First Principles Daily
metadata.description: A daily narrative podcast that reasons about the world from first principles — the 'magic wand number' and the 'Idiot Index'. Episodes alternate between a concrete example of first-principles thinking in action (historical and modern — Ford, Bessemer, the shipping container, solar, batteries, and sometimes Musk's teams) and a deep exposé on an industry ripe for the same treatment.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Models & Agents
metadata.description: Your daily briefing on AI models and agents: new releases from the frontier labs, open-weight drops, agent frameworks, benchmarks, pricing, and practical tools you can use the same day — with long-running program tracking so you always know where the big stories stand. For developers, builders, and AI practitioners.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Models & Agents for Beginners
metadata.description: AI for beginners and teens — daily episodes that explain how models and agents actually work, with free hands-on experiments you can try in minutes, no coding needed. Our sister show Models & Agents covers the expert builder view; this is the same AI universe explained for everyone. Every expert started exactly here.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Modern Investing Techniques
metadata.description: Daily investing podcast using AI-driven analysis and modern tools to identify market opportunities, track simulated trades, and teach strategies that aim to outperform index funds. Covering Canadian and US markets with actionable picks, performance tracking, and lessons learned.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Techniques d'investissement modernes
metadata.description: Podcast d'investissement quotidien qui utilise une analyse pilotée par l'IA et des outils modernes pour repérer les opportunités de marché, suivre des trades simulés et enseigner des stratégies visant à surpasser les fonds indiciels. Couvre les marchés canadien et américain avec des recommandations concrètes, le suivi de performance et les leçons apprises.

metadata.name: Omni View - Balanced News Perspectives
metadata.description: The day's most important stories from around the world — explained calmly, from every side. Named sources across the spectrum, genuine disagreements presented at their strongest, jargon translated into plain language, and every day one story about what's actually being done — so listeners from teens to seniors stay informed and curious, without clickbait, doom, or spin. You still shouldn't be able to tell which side we favor.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Planetterrian Daily
metadata.description: Daily science, longevity, and health discoveries across neuroscience, microbiome, cellular aging biology, sleep research, nutrition science, genetics, and regenerative biology. We deliberately minimize drug-industry dealmaking in favour of the broader research shaping how we understand the body.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: SpaceX Daily
metadata.description: The daily companion for following SpaceX as a public company (Nasdaq: SPCX). Starship, Falcon, Starlink, Dragon, Starshield, the SPCX market picture, and the Musk compute stack — xAI, Grok, Colossus, and Cursor — with sources, community buzz, one honest counterpoint, a dedicated AI & Compute segment, and a daily engineering deep dive. Not financial advice.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: SpaceX Quotidien
metadata.description: Le compagnon quotidien pour suivre SpaceX en tant que société cotée (Nasdaq : SPCX). Starship, Falcon, Starlink, Dragon, le point sur le marché SPCX et l’ingénierie ainsi que l’économie derrière la quête d’une vie multiplanétaire — avec sources, buzz communautaire, un contrepoint honnête chaque jour et une plongée approfondie quotidienne en ingénierie. Ceci n’est pas un conseil financier.

metadata.name: Tesla Shorts Time
metadata.description: Every Tesla story that matters, every single day — in about ten focused minutes. The day's top developments with sources, the real-time TSLA picture, what the Tesla community is buzzing about on X, one honest bearish counterpoint, and a daily first-principles analysis that follows the long arcs across the WHOLE business: vehicles, Optimus, Cybercab and robotaxi, FSD, Tesla Energy (Megapack/Powerwall), Tesla Solar, Cortex/Dojo compute, Supercharging, Semi, and manufacturing. Seven days a week, with a Sunday recap that ties the week's threads together.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

metadata.name: Le Temps des Shorts Tesla
metadata.description: Chaque actualité Tesla qui compte, au quotidien — en 15 minutes ciblées. Les principaux développements du jour avec sources, le point TSLA en temps réel, les sujets qui animent la communauté Tesla sur X, un contrepoint baissier honnête et une analyse quotidienne par premiers principes qui suit les grandes trajectoires : Optimus, Cybercab et robotaxi, FSD, véhicules nouvelle génération et cellules 4680. Sept jours sur sept, avec un récapitulatif dominical reliant les fils de la semaine.

metadata.name: Unintended Consequences
metadata.description: Every weekday, one true story of good intentions gone sideways. From cobra bounties in colonial Delhi to recommendation algorithms, each episode follows a single case through the original idea, how it rolled out, the unintended fallout, and the lessons that still apply — told with empathy for the people who tried.  AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.
